title: 【US】Business Development Lead (MJ000045)
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven BD to explore our growth initiatives in the US. This role will identify new Ideal Client Profiles, strategize product market fit, develop local partnerships and drive new client acquisition. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of payment and have a strong mentality of zero-to-one for a new market expansion.

Key Responsibilities
Identify new client segments by understanding their pain points, desired payments solutions, and the unique value proposition of the solution.
Partner with Product team to identify product-market fit by conducting first-hand customer research and gathering insights.
Identify and develop relationship with various industry players, including fast growing vertical AI (SAAS/ token/ data center) partners, to drive US merchant onboarding opportunities.
Develop and execute partnership strategies that align with overall business and sales objectives.
Support sales enablement efforts (e.g. preparing sales library, RFI and RFPs) and negotiating agreements.
Establish key success metrics for business development and partnerships e.g. no. of prospects interviewed, no. of clients onboarded. Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.

What you'll do
Own deals end to end, from first outreach to signature, working alongside a leadership team that also sells
Generate your own pipeline and act as your own SDR until you hire one
Lead sales processes across multiple stakeholders, security reviews, procurement and legal
Spend as much time with customers as possible: meetings, interviews, workshops and industry events.
Bring market feedback to the product team

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business, Finance, Marketing, or related field.
6+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or strategic alliances within FinTech or payments sector.
Deep understanding of AI Saas, token marketplaces, and data centers in the US and strong network across these segments is highly desirable.
Demonstrated track record of sourcing, negotiating, and scaling partnerships.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and work cross-functionally with global and diverse teams.
